description: The session's MCP servers (defined in the launch config) are reported pending at thread start; mcpServer/startupStatus/updated maps starting -> pending, ready -> connected, failed/cancelled -> failed (with its error), one mcp_status per change and none when nothing changed. Synthesised from the codex app-server JSON schema generated by codex-cli 0.144.1 (`codex app-server generate-json-schema`), not captured from a live run: replace with a capture (see crates/codex-adapter/README.md).
